title: GCC DOA and TOA
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/GCC_DOA_and_TOA.md
text: Generalized cross-correlator with phase transform, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Geometry} sets Array geometry; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Source of sensor pairs}, {Sensor pairs}, {Enable correlation output} sets the option to enable correlation output, {Enable delay output} sets the option to enable delay output, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Element type} sets the array element types, {Operating frequency range (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of the antenna or microphone element, {Baffle the back of the element} sets the back response of an Isotropic Antenna element or an Omni Microphone element, {Null axis direction}, {Exponent of cosine pattern} sets the exponents of azimuth and elevation cosine patterns, {Operating frequency vector (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of custom antenna or microphone elements, {Frequency responses (dB)} sets the antenna and microphone frequency response, {Input Pattern Coordinate System} sets the coordinate system of custom antenna pattern, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Phi Angles (deg)} sets the phi angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Theta Angles (deg)} sets the theta angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Magnitude pattern (dB)} sets the magnitude of combined antenna radiation pattern, {Phase pattern (deg)} sets the custom antenna radiation phase pattern, {Align element normal with array normal}, {Radiation pattern beamwidth (deg)} sets the radiation pattern beamwidth, {Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} sets the polar pattern microphone response frequencies, {Polar pattern angles (deg)} sets the polar pattern response angles, {Polar pattern (dB)} sets the custom microphone polar response zeros, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA, {Array size} sets the dimensions of URA array, {Element spacing (m)} sets the spacing between array elements 0.5 for ULA arrays, {Array axis} sets the linear axis direction, {Element lattice} sets the lattice of URA element positions, {Array normal}, {Radius of UCA (m)} sets the uCA array radius, {Element positions (m)} sets the positions of conformal array elements, {Element normals (deg)} sets the direction of conformal array element normal vectors, {Taper} sets the array element tapers, {Subarray definition matrix} defines elements belonging to subarrays logical, {Subarray steering method}, {Phase shifter frequency (Hz)} sets the subarray phase shifting, {Number of bits in phase shifters} sets the subarray steering phase shift quantization, {Subarrays layout} sets the subarray position specification, {Grid size} sets the dimensions of rectangular subarray grid, {Grid spacing (m)} sets the spacing between subarrays on rectangular, {Subarray positions (m)} sets the positions of subarrays, {Subarray normals} sets the direction of subarray normal vectors and {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System. Values come from the instance.
